turn.user_message: Our doctors don’t use voice notes, and we don’t record half of these details today.

text: Fair challenge. I described the evening round as if your doctors already recorded each decision. They don’t, and they don’t need to.
Tojo adds that step as a new layer. What must already exist at your hospital is much smaller.
chat.pointer: The two sheets show what Tojo adds and the little that must already be there.
chat.note: Tojo adds the recording. Your hospital only shares what it already keeps.
prompts: What does our IT team have to do?
What if our notes are on paper?

blocks.title: A new layer, not a new habit
blocks.deck: What Tojo adds to the evening round, and the little your hospital must already have.

blocks.said: Our doctors don’t use voice notes, and we don’t record half of these details today.

supplied.title: A short record of each decision
items: A one-tap form on the ward phone for each decision
The summary drafted from notes already in your files
A daily list of who goes home tomorrow
Reminders to the teams who act that night

required.title: Three things you already have
items: Doctors deciding on the evening round, as today
Notes and reports kept in your hospital software
One person in IT to give read-only access

blocks.threshold: If your notes are kept only on paper, the drafting waits. The one-tap form and the daily list still work from day one.
